content: Driver choice for CGO-free CI: mattn/go-sqlite3 needs CGO_ENABLED=1 plus a C compiler on Linux/macOS/Windows runners and complicates cross-compilation; modernc.org/sqlite is a C-to-Go transpilation, pure Go, cross-compiles trivially, works with CGO_ENABLED=0, ships amd64/arm64 for linux/darwin/windows, at roughly 1.2-2x slower CPU-bound than mattn; ncruces/go-sqlite3 is WASM-based and fast but had a Windows-only WAL-index corruption bug with pooled concurrent writers fixed via copy hardening and direct mapping (PR 405), and omits shared cache; zombiezen wraps modernc. modernc pulls modernc.org/libc and friends (large module) but keeps the repo pure-Go and CI simple, which matches this repo's matrix (ubuntu/macos/windows) and no-CGO posture.
